prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 10:16 vertical room scene illustration for a browser MUD game.
Primary request: Create a dark fantasy painterly environment illustration for the room 「潮汐廣場」 (mist_harbor_tide_plaza) in zone 霧港 (mist_harbor).
Scene source of truth: A foggy harbor tide plaza of wet dark cobblestones, tide marks on stone steps, mooring posts, salt-stained lanterns, ropes, gull silhouettes, and low sea mist rolling between market awnings. The place should read clearly as a harbor town plaza beside the water, with exits leading toward docks, alleys, and harbor services.
Composition: vertical 10:16, environment-focused, the location is the main subject, no oversized character portrait. Small distant figures or silhouettes are allowed only for scale.
Style: Match existing game room art direction: dark fantasy, hand-painted painterly concept art, thick paint texture, low saturation, readable architecture and terrain, clear lantern light.
Readability: recognizable wet stone plaza, harbor edge, tide stairs, mooring posts, ropes, lanterns, fog, and sea-facing layout visible at sidebar size.
Avoid: modern objects, sci-fi, UI, interface elements, readable text, labels, watermark, cartoon chibi style, bright fairy-tale palette, abstract fog-only background, color blocks.
Required phrase alignment: dark fantasy painterly environment illustration, vertical 10:16, consistent style, no UI, no text.
